product.title: Small group DayTrip to Costa Brava and Dalí Museum From Barcelona

description.text: Get away from the Barcelona bustle and into the breeze. On this tour, you’ll leave the big city for the Catalan countryside, your first stop the Dalí Museum in Figueres, the artist’s hometown. Stops include Dalí Theatre-Museum, Figueres, Peratallada, Calella de Palafrugell. Then it’s off to Peratallada—a medieval, carved-stone village—and Calella de Palafrugell, a particularly picturesque fishing village in Costa Brava, filled with narrow alleyways, lined with seaside coves, and brimming with adventure. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
